scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:staging: concurrently -n staging-api,staging-ui -c magenta,yellow --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix backend run dev:staging" "npm --prefix frontend run dev:staging"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
